usage: The word '訂金' is used as a noun to refer to a monetary amount paid in advance to secure a deal or reservation.
It is commonly used in transactions involving housing, car purchases, or service reservations.
'訂金' functions as the subject or object in a sentence.
Phrases like '付訂金' (pay the deposit) or '退訂金' (refund the deposit) are frequently used.
The amount of '訂金' can vary depending on the agreement between parties.
